policy.rule: Every completed commentary leaf should cite multiple independent sources when the subject permits. Separate primary text, historical evidence, geography/archaeology, theological tradition, and interpretation.
policy.uncertainty: Disputed dates, identities, locations, etymologies, authorship, and interpretations must retain uncertainty labels rather than being flattened into a single answer.

sources.name: Project Gutenberg — King James Version
sources.license: Public domain in the USA; Project Gutenberg distribution terms apply
sources.use: Public-domain English comparison text and traditional KJV book naming.

sources.name: Project Gutenberg — Douay-Rheims, Challoner Revision
sources.license: Public domain in the USA; Project Gutenberg distribution terms apply
sources.use: Public-domain Catholic English comparison corpus including deuterocanonical books.

sources.name: United States Conference of Catholic Bishops — Understanding the Bible
sources.use: Catholic guidance on canon, genre, prayerful reading, and interpretation.

sources.name: Vatican — Catechism of the Catholic Church
sources.use: Catholic doctrinal context; label as Catholic teaching, not neutral historical fact.

sources.name: OpenBible.info Bible Geocoding Data
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 dataset; OpenStreetMap-derived portions may carry ODbL
sources.use: Place candidates, coordinates, resolution paths, and confidence. Credit OpenBible.info and retain disputed-location confidence.

sources.name: Pleiades Gazetteer of the Ancient World
sources.license: Open-data terms vary by component; preserve attribution
sources.use: Ancient place identifiers and historical geography cross-check.

sources.name: Bible Odyssey — Society of Biblical Literature
sources.use: Accessible academic biblical scholarship; cite specific article and author.

sources.name: Perseus Digital Library
sources.license: Varies by text; many public-domain translations
sources.use: Greek/Roman primary texts and lexicon/context comparisons.

sources.name: Sefaria
sources.license: Varies by text; preserve source-specific licensing
sources.use: Jewish textual tradition and classical commentary; present as Jewish interpretation, not as a Catholic doctrinal source.

sources.name: New Advent — Catholic Encyclopedia / Fathers
sources.license: Many hosted historical works are public domain; verify item-specific status
sources.use: Historical Catholic commentary and patristic references; note age of older scholarship.

sources.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Heilbrunn Timeline of Art History
sources.use: Material culture, objects, empires, and visual context.
